bio_am: Ծնած է Սեբաստիոյ Կովտուն գիւղը՝ 1877-ին։ Սասունի (1904), Ղարաբաղի (1905-6) եւ Պաքուի (1918) հերոսը, ինկաւ Պաքուի մէջ՝ 4 Օգոստոս 1918-ին։
bio_en: Murad Hakobian Khrimian was born in 1877 in the village of Kovtun near Sebastia into a family of wandering sieve-makers, worked on the land until about twenty and then went to Constantinople as a porter. Shaken by the Hamidian massacres, he took part in the Bab-i Ali demonstration of 1895, carried out an act of terror and fled to Greece and Egypt, then crossed with Zhirayr of Zeitun to the Caucasus, where they organised the Kars region and he punished several informers. In 1902 he fought in the 'Shant' band, in 1903 went to Sasun with Tuman Tumanian's band to join Andranik, and in 1904 broke out with Andranik through Aghtamar and Van to Persia; in 1905-06 he led the Armenian self-defence in Ganja, Shushi, Goris and Kapan. After the 1908 constitution he made Sebastia his base for years; hunted in 1915, he escaped by sailing boat from near Samsun to Batum, joined the volunteer movement, and was killed in the defence of Baku on 4 August 1918.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: high.
